info.title: MICROSERVICE-apiwizruntimedoc-List Mortgage Loans Status-v5-spec
info.description: The Mortgage Loans Status API provides users with real-time access to the status of mortgage loans. This endpoint allows consumers, such as loan officers and financial institutions, to retrieve detailed information about various loan applications and their current processing status. It enables users to track the progress of mortgage requests, ensuring timely communication with applicants. This API is essential for improving customer service and operational efficiency in mortgage management.

get.description: This endpoint allows you to retrieve the current status of loans. It provides information on approved, pending, and rejected loan applications. Useful for monitoring loan processing.

requestBody.description: This request body allows the client to query the status of loans. It includes necessary parameters to specify which loans are being monitored and may impact the response accordingly.

202.description: The request has been accepted and is being processed.

ListMortgageLoansStatusRequest.description: Represents the request body for the Loan Status operation.
